authority: #K2-480 sec.3.4 termination clause (A also failing => no more variants => sec.15.3 supervisor-domain deliberation). This is the evidence that deliberation needs. Read-only; zero board writes; zero exam runs; no variant attempted.

finding_1_A_extended_the_island_but_the_.correction_of_R1552: R1552 said 'the pad's island now reaches the corridor end, so the start cell is provided'. The maze's own ledger says otherwise: it STILL reports no-free-start-node for I2C2_SCL. The 27 stubs did extend the copper, but the maze's FREE-CELL TEST still fails there - the laid stub is a thin 0.8mm strip between 0.5mm-pitch neighbours and contains no cell that passes the maze's clearance model.

finding_2_the_long_haul_is_obstructed_by.reading: no straight run exists; a weave is required, and the first-steps are inside the dense pin field.

what_this_means_for_the_deliberation: start-freedom is NOT solved by a 0.8mm stub: the maze needs a cell that is free under ITS grid+clearance model, which the dense 0.5mm-pitch neighbourhood does not offer at the pad.

the alternative is that the escape must reach genuinely OPEN space (further than 0.8mm) - but that is 'more of A' (a longer laid corridor), which is a variant, so it is NOT attempted here per the termination clause.
the long haul itself is occupied by GND / PWR_CTRL_OUT / unnamed pads / I2C2_SDA, so even a freed start must weave.
